welcome: This patch reduces background chat errors and fixes quest tooltips and sharing feedback.

sections.title: Background communication
items: QuestTogether hides “player not found” notices caused by its background whispers, cancels queued messages to that player and briefly pauses further attempts. Last-known quest information is kept, and failures remain in diagnostics.
Errors from your own whispers remain visible when their source is uncertain.

sections.title: Quest tooltips
items: “Hide Blizzard quest tooltip” is now on by default for new profiles and after resetting the tracker layout. Existing choices are preserved.
Blizzard’s quest tooltip is hidden only while the Party Objective Tracker is visible and showing that same hovered quest. Hidden trackers, Edit Mode and unrelated tooltips are left alone.

sections.title: Quest sharing
items: Fixed how QuestTogether handles Blizzard’s quest-sharing feedback.
